implementationStateAtFreeze: Design and immutable configuration only; no S06 runtime controller, fixture, calibration, confirmatory, or sensitivity run existed.
frozenQuestion: Does a minimal, explicitly costed local neighbor repair proposal improve operational recovery relative to passive freezing and an identically costed sham, and are its outcomes distinguishable from calibration-duration-matched spontaneous recovery or recovery with matched opportunity and energy costs?
s05Interpretation: S05's robust null constrains contact-conditioned recovery timing alone; it is not evidence against the distinct S06 active intervention, which diverts an action and spends an explicit abstract energy unit.

inherits.checkpointState: occupancy, Selection cursors, activation count/global event clock, native stream counters, native ledger, and a fresh S06 runtime overlay

runtimeOverlay.rootScenarioId: retain the original executable S01 scenario ID
runtimeOverlay.selectedFault: the selected identity is completely mobility-blocked until recovery and remains normal in native policy-visible observations
runtimeOverlay.placement: construct and mechanically validate the native proposal first; then the separate local repair channel may replace that same charged opportunity before commit
runtimeOverlay.recoveryBoundary: the repair proposal opportunity has no occupancy or native-memory effect; successful recovery takes effect for the next charged opportunity
runtimeOverlay.claimBoundary: engineered runtime intervention only; no static-stuck scenario reconstruction, biological repair claim, or changed RNG root

repairProposal.helperEligibility: the uniformly scheduled actor is a normal non-selected identity immediately adjacent to the selected identity while it is frozen
repairProposal.localInformation: a separate intervention gateway exposes only actor identity/position and the Boolean fact that the selected frozen identity is immediately adjacent; it exposes no values, policies, target progress, global occupancy, ledger totals, future draws, or outcomes
repairProposal.nativeReplacement: exactly one already-constructed native NoOp, Swap, or MemoryUpdate is suppressed; no second proposal, retry, replacement actor, or free opportunity is created
repairProposal.successRuleActive: deterministic success when helper eligibility and both local and collective budgets hold
repairProposal.successRuleSham: the identical eligible proposal and costs are recorded, but recovery deterministically does not occur
repairProposal.recoveryTiming: after the triggering batch, effective on the next charged opportunity

costsAndBudgets.energyInterpretation: abstract intervention-accounting unit, not physical energy
costsAndBudgets.budgetConservation: spent plus remaining equals initial for collective actions, collective energy, and every helper; no negative balance and no uncharged successful proposal
costsAndBudgets.nativeOpportunityCost: one ordinary native proposal is suppressed at every repair or matched-cost event

controls.semantics: the selected identity remains runtime-frozen for the phase; no repair channel, spontaneous recovery, dummy stream, or intervention cost
recover at an outcome-blind calibration-assigned active-rescue duration or remain unrecovered for a sentinel; do not suppress a native opportunity or charge energy
use the same local eligibility, one-attempt budget, native-opportunity suppression, and energy charge as active rescue, but the proposal has no recovery effect

at the calibration-assigned active-rescue duration, suppress one charged native opportunity, spend one abstract energy unit, and recover after that opportunity; unrecovered donor sentinels schedule neither recovery nor cost

matching.donorPackage: calibration active-rescue recovery duration plus explicit recovery censor, repair-action count, and energy spent
matching.assignment: counter-addressed deterministic bijection between calibration donors and confirmatory recipients within each declared stratum
matching.runtimeDraws: none; assigned schedules and cost packages are frozen before control trajectories
matching.censoring: unrecovered calibration cases remain sentinels and are never dropped, substituted, or imputed
matching.outcomeConditioningProhibited: assignment strata, ranks, durations, and costs do not use confirmatory completion, distance, recovery, terminal, or trade-off outcomes

pairingContract.preProcess: all arms share the exact S02 checkpoint, S03 reversal anchor occupancy/hash, selected identity, global clock, native stream counters, ledger, target, and phase budget
pairingContract.baseRuntimeRoot: same original executable scenario ID and seed
pairingContract.baseStreamStatus: shared prefix until intervention, state-path, or terminal divergence
pairingContract.repairChannel: endogenous and stream-free; worker order never enters eligibility or matching
pairingContract.matchingStream: construction-only isolated stream with no dummy runtime draws
pairingContract.staticReconstructionContrast: not executed; reconstructed stuck scenario remains RNG-unpaired

tradeoffMetrics: completion and paired completion risk difference
post-opportunity strict-inversion distance area under the curve
recovery incidence and duration with censor retention
repair proposals, successes, shams, and schedule events
native opportunities suppressed and forgone native proposal kind/eligibility
completion benefit per mean energy unit as a descriptive aggregate

validationPanel.sourceConstruction: exact reconstruction of all validated S02 checkpoints followed by the validated S03 central segment reversal anchor

primaryContrasts: active_assisted_rescue versus spontaneous_time_matched under the primary matching choice
active_assisted_rescue versus matched_time_opportunity_energy under the primary matching choice
successCriteria.primaryEndpoint: confirmatory final-target completion with every terminal and unrecovered case retained
successCriteria.test: two-sided exact McNemar test on discordant pairs
successCriteria.multiplicity: Holm correction across the four primary contrasts at family-wise alpha 0.05
successCriteria.supportive: all validation gates pass, active rescue has a positive completion difference from the sham, and the active-versus-sham Holm-adjusted p value is at most 0.05, with no Holm-significant active harm
successCriteria.null: all validation gates pass and no active-rescue completion advantage is Holm-significant
successCriteria.constrainingContradictory: a required semantic, budget, ledger, matching, replay, pairing, censor, or accounting gate fails, or active rescue has a Holm-significant completion harm
successCriteria.uncertainty: paired mean-difference 95% t intervals and exact McNemar inference; no survivor-only analysis
successCriteria.censorRule: retain every non-recovery, quiescent, and phase-budget case; do not form a recovered-only or completed-only cohort

claimBoundary: S06 tests an engineered local intervention inside the transparent simulator. Repair proposals, action costs, energy, rescue, and trade-offs are operational constructs, not biological mechanisms, physical energy, or wet-lab evidence.
